title: Malaysia's banks, six ways
scaleNote: The page is laid out for phones, so the film is shot at 432x768 CSS pixels at 2.5x.
gapNote: Seconds held after each voice line ends, before the next shot cuts.
orderNote: The page runs size first and then the five other measures. The film keeps that spine but cuts it to one argument: a premise card says size is one number of six, the skyline shows how lopsided size is, the profit swap and the six ranks show the order breaking, the region and DBS say what the gap means, and the leads card says what to look at instead. The blocks and dials scenes stay on the page; two more scenes would not fit a minute.
